# Security Policy

> **TL;DR**
>
> - Found a vulnerability? Report it privately, never in a public issue.
> - Preferred: GitHub private vulnerability reporting. Alternative: security@kylehub.dev.
> - Only current `main` gets fixes.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes target current development on `main`. Older commits have no support guarantee.
Spellbook is unreleased, see the [pre-release policy](../CONTRIBUTING.md#replacing-interfaces).

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Use one of these channels:

1. **GitHub private vulnerability reporting** for this repository (preferred).
2. **Email:** security@kylehub.dev

Include:

- [ ] A clear description of the issue.
- [ ] Steps to reproduce.
- [ ] The potential impact.
- [ ] A suggested fix, if you have one.

## Response

This is a personal project, so response times vary. I will acknowledge reports as soon as I can and
work on a fix.

Please do not disclose the vulnerability publicly until a fix is available.
